observations: Photo 0: A full-size, cabinet-style sewing machine on a wooden table/stand; metal bed and foot pedal area visible.
Photo 1: Close side view of the machine head; multiple knobs/dials and a front control panel are visible; some wear/paint scuffs on the machine body.
Photo 2: Front view of the machine head; the brand name on the head appears to be present but is not clearly readable in the photo.
Photo 3: Rear/side view showing the handwheel/pulley area and the table/stand; overall looks used with visible wear.

claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear/scuffs on the machine head and body; no close-up of stitching test, lights, or mechanical sound.
No clearly readable brand/model plate or country-of-origin marking is legible in the provided photos.
No video/audio of the motor running or sewing test is provided.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual.
claims.evidence: No accessories/manual are shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No service records or internal inspection photos are provided.

risks.risk: Whether it actually sews properly (timing, needle/bar alignment, feed mechanism) and not just powers on.
risks.proof: A short video of a full sewing test on fabric (straight stitch + turning corner) showing even stitches and no thread bunching.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used and not proven to sew correctly (worst case: needs adjustment/repair).

risks.risk: Motor/drive condition (belt, pulley, bearings) and whether it runs smoothly under load.
risks.proof: Video of the motor running and sewing at speed for 1–2 minutes, plus a close-up of the belt/pulley area if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven smooth (worst case: may need motor/drive service).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (needles, bobbins, presser feet, power cord, tools) and whether the manual is included.
risks.proof: Photo inventory laid out on a surface: needles, bobbins, presser feet, power cable, any tools, and the manual cover/pages.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete (worst case: accessories/manual not included).

risks.risk: Exact brand/model unknown, which affects value and parts availability.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the brand/model nameplate on the machine head and any serial plate on the body/table.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at a generic used cabinet sewing machine level (worst case: hard-to-value/parts uncertainty).

risks.risk: Condition of the machine bed and rust/corrosion not fully visible (could affect smooth feeding).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle plate/bed, feed dogs, and underside of the presser foot area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially worn (worst case: needs cleaning/maintenance).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the brand/model plate and serial number (so the exact machine can be identified).
Video of a sewing test on fabric (showing stitch quality and feed).
Video of the motor running and sewing at speed for at least 1–2 minutes.
Photos of all included accessories and the manual (laid out and readable).
response.reason: The photos show a used cabinet sewing machine, but the key details that determine price (exact brand/model, confirmed smooth operation, and included accessories/manual) are not verifiable from the images alone.
